recipes.name: Ackee and corned pork
ingredients: 250 g fully cooked corned pork, diced
steps: Desalt the corned pork if needed and cook it thoroughly before using.
Sauté onion and scallion in oil until soft.
Add diced pork and tomato and heat through.
Fold in drained, commercially prepared ackee gently and cook until hot.

recipes.name: Salt mackerel with boiled food
steps: Soak and simmer salted mackerel in fresh water, repeat until pleasantly salted, then debone.
Peel and boil yam and green banana until tender.
Sauté onion, scallion and tomato until softened.
Add flaked mackerel, heat through and serve with boiled provisions.

recipes.name: Roast breadfruit with saltfish
steps: Roast breadfruit on indirect heat, turning until uniformly soft, then peel and core.
Desalt cod by simmering in fresh water and remove bones.
Sauté aromatics in oil, add flaked cod and warm through.
Slice breadfruit and serve beside saltfish.

recipes.name: Coconut drops breakfast variation
steps: Line a heat-safe tray with parchment.
Bring sugar and water to a boil and dissolve completely.
Stir in coconut and ginger and cook until syrup thickens.
Drop spoonfuls onto tray and cool fully; this is a sweet treat, not a nutritionally balanced breakfast.

recipes.name: Cassava bammy
ingredients: 500 g commercially processed food-safe cassava meal
steps: Use food-safe prepared cassava meal rather than untreated bitter cassava.
Combine meal and salt, moisten according to package processing instructions, and shape flat rounds.
Cook rounds in a lightly oiled skillet until firm and lightly browned.
Briefly soak in coconut milk and return to pan until cooked through.

recipes.name: Johnny cakes
steps: Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Add water gradually to make a soft dough; rest covered 10 minutes.
Divide into eight portions and shape flat rounds.
Fry over moderate heat, turning, until golden and the centers are cooked.

recipes.name: Coco bread
steps: Combine flour, yeast, sugar and salt; add milk and softened butter.
Knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and prove until doubled.
Divide into eight pieces, roll into ovals and fold each over with a little butter inside.
Prove briefly and bake at 190°C/375°F for 15–20 minutes until cooked.

recipes.name: Hard dough bread
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar and salt; add water and butter to form a firm dough.
Knead thoroughly, cover and rise until nearly doubled.
Shape tightly into a greased loaf tin and prove until risen above rim.
Bake at 190°C/375°F for 30–40 minutes until baked through; cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Bulla cake
steps: Mix flour, ginger, baking powder and baking soda.
Stir molasses, sugar and water together and combine with dry ingredients.
Shape into small flat rounds on a lined tray.
Bake at 175°C/350°F for 15–20 minutes, checking that the centers have set.

recipes.name: Easter bun
ingredients: 200 ml stout or nonalcoholic malt drink
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C/350°F and grease a loaf tin.
Mix flour, baking powder and spices, then add sugar and fruit.
Stir in malt beverage until a thick batter forms.
Bake 50–65 minutes until center is set; cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Spiced bun and cheese
steps: Slice a fully cooled bun evenly.
Cut cheese into six thin portions.
Place cheese between pairs of bun slices or serve open-faced.
Serve immediately; refrigerate leftover cheese promptly.

recipes.name: Jackass corn
steps: Mix flour, ginger and baking powder.
Rub in butter and work in sugar dissolved in water to create firm dough.
Roll out thinly and cut into small rounds or squares.
Bake at 180°C/355°F until dry and crisp, approximately 15–22 minutes.

recipes.name: Turn cornmeal
steps: Sauté chopped onion and scallion in oil until softened.
Add water, coconut milk and thyme and bring to a simmer.
Whisk in cornmeal gradually to prevent lumps.
Cook on low, stirring often, for 20–25 minutes until thick and fully cooked.

recipes.name: Cornmeal cou-cou
steps: Slice okra and simmer in water until tender.
Whisk cornmeal slowly into simmering okra liquid.
Cook on low, stirring vigorously, until the grain softens and mass thickens.
Stir in butter, season lightly and shape to serve.

recipes.name: Jerk pork
steps: Blend scallions, garlic, bonnet, allspice, lime, thyme and oil into a paste.
Coat pork, refrigerate at least 4 hours and discard used marinade.
Slow-roast covered at 160°C/325°F or cook by indirect barbecue until tender and food-safe.
Rest before slicing; use a thermometer and follow a validated pork temperature recommendation.

recipes.name: Oxtail and broad beans
steps: Brown seasoned oxtail in a heavy pot and drain excess rendered fat.
Add onion, scallion, garlic, thyme, browning and water.
Cover and simmer 2.5–3.5 hours, replenishing water until meat is tender.
Add cooked broad beans for the last 15 minutes and reduce sauce.

recipes.name: Pepper steak
steps: Slice beef against the grain and pat dry.
Sear beef in hot oil in batches; remove from pan.
Sauté onion, garlic and peppers until crisp-tender.
Return beef with stock and soy sauce, simmer briefly until cooked and sauce lightly reduces.

recipes.name: Brown stew pork
steps: Pat pork dry and sear in batches in oil.
Add chopped onion, tomato, pepper and thyme and cook 4 minutes.
Stir in browning and water, cover and simmer gently until pork is tender.
Uncover to thicken sauce and verify meat is thoroughly cooked.

recipes.name: Gungo peas soup
steps: Combine peas, pumpkin, yam, carrots, onion and thyme with water.
Bring to a boil then simmer until vegetables begin to soften.
Make a stiff dough from flour and water, form small spinners and add.
Cook 15–20 minutes more until dumplings and vegetables are done, adjusting seasoning.

recipes.name: Chicken foot soup
steps: Blanch cleaned chicken feet in boiling water, drain and replace with fresh water.
Simmer with onion and thyme until feet become tender, generally 1–2 hours.
Add pumpkin, yam and carrots and simmer until nearly tender.
Add small flour spinners and cook another 15–20 minutes; ensure poultry is thoroughly cooked.
